note.specFocus: Opinions on fame, role models, influencers and social-media stars, advantages and disadvantages of celebrity, and influence on young people.
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written to match the AQA GCSE German (8668) themes; no supplied booklet used.
note.summary:
2.3 Celebrity culture
Key vocabulary
- berühmt = famous
- der Star/das Vorbild = star/role model
- der Influencer/die Influencerin = influencer
- die Follower = followers
- bekannt machen = to make famous
- die Privatsphäre = privacy

Key grammar
- Opinion clauses: ich finde, dass...; meiner Meinung nach...; verbs go at the end after dass.
- Relative clauses: der Star, der... / die Sängerin, die... .
- Comparisons and concessions: berühmter als..., obwohl ...; useful for balanced views.

Exam tips
- Use a range of vocabulary but keep German word order accurate.
- Justify opinions with denn/weil and a clear reason; check present, perfect, future and conditional time frames.
- In comprehension, distinguish nicht, kein and nie: negatives may reverse the intended answer.
